decisions.reason: Selecting a whisk style suited to fine powder does not change the established 4.5 qt bowl capacity, depth, or refilling policy.
The source selects a whisk-head style but does not change the requirement to minimize splashing.
The whisk reference is a design choice intended to support fine-powder mixing; it does not modify the existing mixing-quality or foam-consistency acceptance targets.
The selected whisk style does not necessarily alter the enclosure size or side-profile constraints.
The source concerns the functional style of the whisk head, not the machine's DJ-turntable visual identity.
The whisk design selection does not change the branded placard text.
The source does not modify the machine's beige primary color or green accent color.
The whisk-head reference is independent of the requested spout appearance.
Selecting a whisk style does not change the standard 120V power-source requirement or the deferred battery option.
The source does not change the obligation or detail level for the basic wiring plan.
The selected whisk style does not modify the controlled-pour, anti-drip, flow-rate, or beverage-preservation requirements.
Although the selected component may later be represented in design work, the source does not change the system-layout deliverable itself.
